goalInOwnWords: You pick one part each round and build a conveyor line so scrap turns into gold bars you sell for money. Fill the orders to get stars and beat the foreman Sal's score.
stoppedWhere: On the Plate Press build screen of a 'try again from shift 6' retry, right after finishing my first full game on today's yard (2 stars, $15,842, beat Sal by $20). Left through Menu, Save and go home, then the feedback survey.
stoppedWhy: I'd already beaten Sal, and only by $20 by selling two spare cards, which feels cheap. The retry for the third star was a puzzle with no clue: all three cards said 'No easy spot yet', the dock is boxed in by other machines, and the pay would not move off $4,050. I'm not tapping around for another few minutes, and there is nobody to send a score to.

stuck.where: Today's yard, shift 2 (and again shift 4): picking Hopper + Crusher
stuck.what: Sal said 'Tap the lit spot for the Scrap Hopper, step 1 of 2' but the part the game had selected was the Crusher, so my tap put a crusher where the hopper should go. The hint text did not change and no lit spot was left to tap.
stuck.gotOutHow: Tapped the hopper on the shelf and then the glowing crusher on the yard, which swapped them. Second time I tapped the hopper on the shelf first.

stuck.where: Shift 5 build screen with the Tuner
stuck.what: All three cards said 'No easy spot yet' and every cell touching the furnaces was already used, so I could not work out where the Tuner should go or whether anything could help. The game had said a Tuner touching the furnace would clear the problem.
stuck.gotOutHow: Did not really. Tried about four spots, the forecast stayed at $3,600 each time, then pressed go anyway.

stuck.what: Tapping a part that is already on the yard with a new part selected just selects the old part, it does not swap. Even after sending a piece back to the shelf I had to tap the new part on the shelf again before a tap on the yard would place it. About 35 taps to try one idea.
stuck.gotOutHow: Back to the shelf on the splitter and then the belt, re-tapped the Tuner on the shelf, tapped the empty cell.

stuck.what: Could not see how to make the extra $550 for the third star. No card had an easy spot and the Plate Press had no way to reach the dock.
stuck.gotOutHow: Gave up: Menu, Save and go home.

confused: Lesson 1 said the line needs Hopper, Crusher, Furnace, Dock, but the line was already closed and paying with just the Hopper and Dock.
A red 'held you back' tag appeared on a machine at the end of lesson 1 with no explanation.
At first I did not know what 'Order $450' meant. I guessed each shift is one order and the dots at the top are the six orders.
'You're level with Sal' five times in a row. I only understood why when I added up the shifts and got exactly Sal's total.
The game said nothing held me back, add a hopper, and the extra hopper and crusher were worth only $42 on the forecast.
The Tuner was 'Fits this line now' on shift 3, then the Tuner I was told would clear the furnace did nothing on shift 5.
Hint says place the Hopper but the Crusher is what gets placed.
The 'Next shift: ...' line under the cards, I did not know what it was telling me.
'No easy spot yet' on every card in the last two shifts: I did not know if that meant impossible or just hard.
annoyed: Lesson 1 and the first guided shifts: the game tells me exactly what to tap every time, I made zero decisions for the first few minutes.
Hint text and the selected part do not match on Hopper + Crusher picks, which cost me taps both times.
Too many taps to rearrange anything on a phone: tapping a placed piece selects instead of swapping, so everything goes back to the shelf first.
The advice to add a hopper did almost nothing because the furnace was the real limit.
No leaderboard in the test version, so the only thing to beat is Sal and following the lit spots ties me with him.
A $40 re-roll that comes out of the score on the last shift.
Beating Sal came down to selling two cards for $20, which feels like a trick, not skill.
pleased: Seeing 'This shift will pay $576 (up $465)' before I press go, the number jumping each time I add a machine.
Gold bars, glowing furnaces and the big 'ORDER FILLED' banner.
4x speed makes a shift a few seconds long.
'Sal's game: $15,822. Beat it.' and then 'You beat Sal by $20'.
The 'what held you back' box says the weak spot in plain words.
'One more order for 3 stars' with a one-shift 'Try again from shift 6' button.
Starts right away with no sign-in, and the lesson is short.
Sell for $10 on a card let me pad the score on the last shift.
bestMoment: Shift 4: the big yellow 'ORDER FILLED! Every price up 25%' banner with the furnaces glowing and gold bars sliding to the dock.
worstMoment: Shift 5: every card said 'No easy spot yet', I spent about 35 taps trying to fit a Tuner and the pay never moved from $3,600.
oneChange: A real score to beat: a board with other people or friends (or a way to send my score to a friend), instead of a foreman ghost I tie by just following the lit spots.
